text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon placed excellently in the
Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hand in hand, we've been able to work
our way
through the first three pivotal
years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a day of respite, while basking in the
glory of
our accomplishments...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Heh-heh-heh. Hey, Trainer! You've
been
spacing out for quite some time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Little do you know, I've actually been
here for the
past five minutes. I fear your
sense of danger is a
cause for concern.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nothing much. I just wanted to
extend an
invitation to you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That is, to go on a "date."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Agnes Tachyon and I set off on
our
"date" together.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A book I read recommended it for being
"replete
with curiosities to promote
conversation."
choice_data_list: 水族館なんて、意外だな
水族館なんて、意外だね
choice_data_list_en: An aquarium, huh? That's kind of surprising.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Look around at these tanks made of such

beautiful acrylic glass! We are beholden
to it, the
savior of all aquariums.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Many issues would arise during the time
when
reinforced glass was the norm,
especially in
regard to its manufactu—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...I'm off the mark, aren't I? Fish, right?
The
fishes... Oh, how pretty. Like,
colorful, aren't
they?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Okay, next we go shopping! In a
shopping mall as
big as this, your desire
to buy should be amply
stimulated.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer? Don't you want to shop
for
anything?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's problematic, as I too have
no desire
to shop. I typically make all my
purchases online.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Very well! Onward! To the next
destination!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our "date" continues until I realize the
sun is
setting.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Time sure flew right by, didn't it? Well
now, after
the "date," do you feel any
different?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Does your heart ache? Do you find it
hard to
breathe or difficult to think
straight? Please, do
report anything that
comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The word "report" rings a bell in my
mind. Could it
be that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't it obvious? Are you really just
realizing
now?
choice_data_list: ……今日は何かの実験だったのか？
……今日は何かの実験だったの？

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We've known each other for three whole
years!
Why would I go on a date with
you without good
reason?
choice_data_list_en: There's no way I'd notice that!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I want to record the emotions you're
feeling at
this exact moment. Whatever
comes to mind is
fine, just describe them
in detail.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's difficult to turn her down when she
gets like
this. I try to think of something
that might satisfy
her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Okay, and? What else?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Argh! Not quite what I was looking for!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wrong! Don't you feel anything like...
butterflies
in your stomach, or a spark
between us?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... My apologies for losing my
cool. I don't
take failure very well when
it comes to my
research.
choice_data_list: （ド、ドキドキとかトキメキとか！？）

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's the fundamental factor of the social
animal,
those things we call "emotions."
choice_data_list_en: ...What kind of research is this, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I faintly remember her saying something
similar
once before.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've become increasingly curious
about the
powers that stem from factors
like "enthusiasm"
and "passion."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back on it, she expressed her
interest in
emotions quite a while before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was a passing curiosity, but
that no
longer seems to be the case.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was made painfully aware... that my
long-held
hypothesis is filled with flaws.
choice_data_list: どうしてそんなに興味があるんだ？
どうしてそんなに興味があるの？

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I had always known that a multitude of
factors
affect our running.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But far from being fixed determiners,
they were
nothing more than effects
resulting from minor
interactions.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That is what I firmly believed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She slowly closes her eyes, as if to
better
remember that event.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That day, during the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the race, I was greeted by
a
passionate roar of cheers from the
stands.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I could even hear their voices during the
race, like
a strong tailwind lending me
strength.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That is what inspired the desire in me to
thank
them sincerely. Casting my gaze
toward the
stands, it dawned upon me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Winning the race that day... And not
only that,
but managing to reach the
Classics with my own
two feet...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All of these accomplishments were,
perhaps, only
possible due to emotion.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It occurred to me that I might have
severely
underestimated the true extent
of its power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon opens her eyes slowly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In retrospect, I was only able to choose
the road
toward success because of your
sentiments.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, words I would casually
impart
often had a large effect on her
decision-making.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After all, I always wanted her to discover
the
"limits of Umamusume-kind" through
her own
efforts.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, I used to believe that things
like
emotions were the furthest from the
realm of
science.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But color me surprised, science and
human
emotion are inseparable! Oh, how
naive I have
been!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Throughout these past three years, the
subject of
emotions seems to have
captivated Agnes
Tachyon more than I
realized.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If we are to aim higher still, it is
imperative to
decipher and examine
these emotions to the
fullest!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't you agree, my dear guinea
pig?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So once again, I find myself surprised at
her
underlying motive.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What? Finish your sentence. You've
made me
curious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She conquered the limits of her own
Umamusume
body, and in her senior
year, managed to realize
her childhood
dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at it another way, that same

experiment-loving troublemaker is just a
diligent
hard worker.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Heh-heh-heh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Hey, come on! Did you really
have to put
it that way? That was
borderline slander!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And a first, too. Some might've called
me
self-centered, or a lone wolf, but
never a fanatic!
Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I must've hit a funny bone, as her
laughter doesn't
subside for quite a
while.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh... That was a good one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Though, since your impression comes
from a
three-year-long history together,
it must have
some truth to it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back, you've done a lot for me.
At the
risk of sounding cliché...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm deeply thankful that you chose to be
my
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll say it again, although it's a bit
embarrassing,
but thank you for
everything. You've been a great
help to
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I never could've imagined Agnes
Tachyon
expressing her gratitude with
such sincerity. It's
enough to make me
crack a smile.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thank you so much. You are
undeniably a
fantastic...
choice_data_list: 俺も、君が担当ウマ娘でよかった！
私も、貴方が担当ウマ娘でよかった！
choice_data_list_en: I'm so glad you're my trainee too!
I'm so glad to have you as my trainee too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A fantastic guinea pig, heh-heh-heh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, guinea pig, can you tell me once
again how
you feel at this moment?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In Agnes Tachyon's hands are a heart
rate
monitor and a voice recorder, raring
to go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, our eyes are set on the
potential of
Umamusume and that which
lies beyond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the next chapter of our journey has
only just
begun.
